items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: met Katherine and Basie are very dear friends

ctx.x: Oh, it was just great. Bill Robinson‟s got a little cottage on the stage, a little cottage on the stage with a picket fence around it. Bill Austin is standing at the gate with a valise, his bag. Katherine Perry, who‟s the lady that used to be Earl Hines wife, Katherine Perry is inside the picket gate by the house and she‟s singing Don’t Worry About Me, I’ll Get Along.
